title: THE SECRET OF THE SCOOTERS 🛵
topic: The mystery of the stolen scooters is finally revealed during a high-speed race.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I CAN NOT STOP THIS THING [beat] AND THE LAKE IS GETTING WAY TOO CLOSE FOR COMFORT AT THIS SPEED!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: DO NOT YOU DARE SLOW DOWN NOW NIX [beat] BECAUSE DING IS RIGHT ON YOUR TAIL AND HE WANTS THAT FREE LUNCH!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: I AM WINNING THIS RACE [beat] AND YOU GUYS ARE DEFINITELY BUYING ME THE BIGGEST PIZZA IN THE ENTIRE CITY TODAY!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: WAIT [beat] WHY IS PRINCIPAL HUDA STANDING IN THE MIDDLE OF THE PARK WITH A CLIPBOARD AND A POLICE WHISTLE?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: STOP RIGHT THERE EVERY SINGLE ONE OF YOU [beat] UNLESS YOU WANT TO EXPLAIN WHY YOU ARE RIDING THE TECH LAB PROTOTYPES!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: EXPERIMENTAL PROTOTYPES [beat] WE FOUND THESE ABANDONED IN THE SCHOOL BASEMENT NEAR THE JANITOR CLOSET LAST NIGHT!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: THOSE WERE CONFISCATED FROM BRUNO [beat] AND THEY HAVE GPS TRACKERS THAT ALARMED THE SECOND YOU CROSSED THE PARK GATE!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: SO WE ARE NOT GETTING LUNCH [beat] WE ARE GETTING EXPELLED FOR SOMETHING WE THOUGHT WAS JUST A COOL FIND?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: HOLD ON [beat] LOOK AT THE BOTTOM OF THE SCOOTER FRAME [beat] THERE IS A STAMP THAT SAYS PROPERTY OF RAFIQ!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I HAVE BEEN LOOKING FOR MY VINTAGE COLLECTION EVERYWHERE [beat] HUDA [beat] WHY DID YOU CONFISCATE MY PRIVATE PROPERTY FROM MY SON?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I HAD NO IDEA THEY BELONGED TO YOU RAFIQ [beat] I ASSUMED THEY WERE ILLEGAL IMPORTS FROM THE WAY BRUNO WAS SPRINTING!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: SO SINCE DAD OWNED THEM ALL ALONG [beat] DOES THAT MEAN HE IS THE ONE WHO HAS TO PAY FOR OUR LUNCH?

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: NICE TRY NIX [beat] BUT SINCE YOU NEARLY BROKE THE BRAKES [beat] YOU ARE ALL SPENDING THE WEEKEND CLEANING MY GARAGE!
